text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer passed by like a flash of light. A 
summer where all the Mejiro Umamusume 
raced through as one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And Mejiro Bright...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Impressive. To think you actually 
completed all that training.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And though it took some time, in the end, 
she managed to master it all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"That's just the kind of girl Bright is. 
She looks easygoing on the surface, but 
the truth is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She's an Umamusume harboring incredible 
drive. With a spirit stronger than anyone 
else's...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having given it her all, she was utterly 
exhausted. Right now, she was just a 
sleeping princess. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Power undeniably dwells within. Yes, from 
the moment of awakening...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer~...? Good morning~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I must have dozed off before I knew it... 
Um, what time is it now...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Early morning, is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My... morning...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So that must be why the sunlight feels so 
dazzling~. Surely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have received so much light. 
Small fragments of the Mejiro light.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The gathered light turned into a brilliant 
sun inside me, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how much of this radiance 
will reach Lady Suzuka~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we can surpass them. Or perhaps we 
won't stand a chance, and Mejiro will be 
buried in the sands of time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: You never know until you try. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I... believe in you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That our beloved Mejiro— will surely shine 
bright in the next era as well.
